title: Filling in the Holes: Creating Structures
coreMove: Embodied symbolic repair gives missing protection a form the body can register, without pretending the past was different.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A trainee can confuse the PBSP structure with performance unless the roles stay precise.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Pesso's workshop method as embodied mapping rather than theater.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A loving but unsafe caregiver can be separated from the protection that was missing.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Separate real caregiver facts from ideal protective response.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A case team may overexplain symptoms while missing the relational map.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Externalize the relational map before interpreting the case.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A record of events may miss the protective response the child needed.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use ideal figures without denying the factual record.

exampleSpecs.audience: counselors supporting a student after disclosure
exampleSpecs.stakes: A student may need witnessed truth before advice can land.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Make witness and ideal support concrete in physical space.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A legal account can verify facts without giving the body a protective scene.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Contrast factual confrontation with a symbolic paternal response.
